dedupe_keys.name: supplementary information to water science and technology polyphenol extraction from industrial water by products ultimate project fruit processing industry case study

description: The supplementary dataset provides identified compounds and calculated concentrations in resin and processed streams, plus extracted-ion chromatograms and spectra. It is explicitly related to the mobile-treatment polyphenol extraction study in the Nafplio juice factory. The study compares conventional solvent extraction, subcritical water extraction and supercritical carbon-dioxide extraction. A PDF document is listed; the inspected metadata do not establish individual analyte names, limits of detection, replicates or internal table format. Reported analytical results describe that treatment study and do not prove general commercial performance. The source documents a water quality treatment or recovery study. The source authors provide this description through Zenodo, whose deposit declares CC BY 4.0 and public document access. Geographic and temporal coverage remain limited to the cases or observations explicitly described. Only metadata and file descriptors were reviewed; no document, measurements, model archive or code was read. Related components retain their source identities and uncertain experimental overlap.
